err.option_locked: Your department has fixed this option, so you can't change it.
err.option_value: That choice isn't available for this option.
err.option_config: An officer option here is unknown or has a value it can't take.
options.subtitle: Set the tablet up for yourself. Every change saves on its own.
options.chip.server_hint: Saved with this character, on any PC.
options.chip.local_hint: Kept on this PC only, for every character you play here.
options.locked_text: An admin has turned officer options off on this server, so everyone keeps the defaults.
options.look.title: Tablet look and privacy
options.keys.title: My keys
options.keys.hint: Change them in GTA Settings > Key Bindings > FiveM.
options.key.hudSide_hint: The side of the screen the mission HUD sits on. Notifications stay top right.
options.key.hudScale_hint: 1 is the normal size; it still grows and shrinks with your screen.
options.key.hudCompact_hint: Show only the current objective, how many are done and the timer.
options.key.reduceMotion_hint: The HUD and notifications appear without sliding in or flashing.
options.key.hudLook: Use my tablet look on the HUD
options.key.hudLook_hint: The mission HUD, the result card and notifications use your tablet look and accent instead of the department colours.
options.key.textSize_hint: Large text makes the words on the tablet and the mission HUD bigger.
options.key.toastTime_hint: How long notifications stay on screen. Warnings and errors stay a little longer.
options.key.resultTime_hint: Seconds the mission result card stays on screen. You can always close it sooner.
options.key.quietRun_hint: During a mission, unit invites, commendations, rewards and profile news go only to the bell. Route, custody and mission messages, warnings and errors still pop up.
